description: PEMBROKE PARK, Fla. — On the latest episode of “This Week in South Florida” host Glenna Milberg welcomed State Rep. Berny Jacques, Broward County Commissioner Beam Furr, Raymer Maguire with the Cleo Institute, Miami-Dade County Commissioner Raquel Regalado and El Portal Mayor Omarr Nickerson.
